# Read Primitives — Decimal Order By

```{tags} reference, query-template, read_primitives
```

> [Read Primitives](../../read-primitives.md) benchmark · [all Read Primitives queries](index.md)

Multi-column sort with mixed ASC/DESC on decimal columns

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
/* Multi-column sort with mixed ASC/DESC on decimal columns */ /* l_orderkey is the tertiary tie-break so the LIMIT 100 boundary is a total order */ /* (l_extendedprice, l_discount tie at the cutoff). */
SELECT
  l_orderkey,
  l_extendedprice,
  l_discount
FROM lineitem
ORDER BY
  l_extendedprice DESC,
  l_discount ASC,
  l_orderkey ASC
LIMIT 100
```

## Representative DataFrame

Expression family (Polars, PySpark, DataFusion), default parameters.

```python
def orderby_decimal_expression_impl(ctx: DataFrameContext) -> Any:
    """Multi-column sort with mixed ASC/DESC on decimal columns."""
    lineitem = ctx.get_table("lineitem")

    # l_orderkey is the tertiary tie-break (matches the catalog SQL) so the
    # LIMIT-100 boundary over the non-unique (l_extendedprice, l_discount) keys is a
    # total order on both surfaces.
    return (
        lineitem.sort(["l_extendedprice", "l_discount", "l_orderkey"], descending=[True, False, False])
        .select("l_orderkey", "l_extendedprice", "l_discount")
        .limit(100)
    )
```
